findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_best_device, get_reviews · Private data: whats_coming, is_good_price, source_track_record · Public sink: source_track_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_best_device, get_reviews · Private data: whats_coming, is_good_price, source_track_record · Public sink: source_track_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
